summary.headline: Dedication to Ernest and George
summary.text: Dedication praising Frederick II for preserving and translating Arabic astrological books, recounting the manuscript’s concealment among Matthias’s royal treasures, its loss at Buda, and its recovery and sale at Nuremberg. The poem dedicates the works of Messala to Ernest and George, praying for their immortal fame among the stars.
